LOOK | The Manila City Disaster Risk Reduction Management Office (DRRMO) on Friday (November 14, 2025) conducted flushing operations in preparation for the 3-day rally organized by the Iglesia ni Cristo (INC).

The rally calls for transparency and a better democracy. It will be staged at Quirino Grandstand and Burnham Green in the capital city. | via Pot Chavez

📸Manila DRRMO
